Per-line design-menu pairs excluded by QC = 0 for all 125 lines (19,549 designed pairs with both orientations = 19,549 menu pairs): the exported release is already QC-filtered (the builder's RMSE / missing filter removes 0 rows), so pre-export QC exclusions by the authors cannot be counted. The M1 limitation (menu conditions on QC passing) therefore stands unquantified.

The feedback relative-action-value endpoint (AUC among eligible round-2 candidates) is undefined in 76 of 122 E campaigns and 71 of 128 HD campaigns (no joint hit among the eligible candidates); the registered diagnostic decision rests on the 23 E lines with a defined AUC in at least one role.

R's own HD-best fp (30) equals fp* (30) and C*'s own fp is fp*, so the H2 own-fp secondary is numerically identical to the primary; it agrees in sign, so the primary verdict carries no 'C*-optimal split' qualification.

The development R - C* contrast in selection.json is in-sample for the C* selection (winner's curse favours C*) and is not an estimate of the E effect; the power analysis uses its per-line deviations, not its point estimate, for the scenarios.

The frozen builder loads the whole release (including E outcomes) into memory in every stage; the dev and feedback_dev stages remove every E row (TissueData.restrict, world library subset with an assertion) before any computation and write nothing derived from E lines.
